en: Black‑and‑white portrait postcard showing a man and a woman in elegant early‑20th‑century clothing, posing in a theatrical manner. At the top in decorative German script is the title "Der liebe Augustin" and the phrase "Und der Himmel hängt voller Geigen!". At the bottom, the names "Oscar Aigner" and "Käthe Dorsch" identify the performers. In the lower left margin is the photographer/publisher credit "M. Herzfeld Dresden 1913".
